description: This file defines the Table3D class, a Java class representing a 3D data table with functionality for data population, manipulation, display, and clipboard operations within a graphical user interface. It includes methods for interacting with 3D data cells, handling user input, copying, pasting, and interpolating data. The class is part of the com.romraider.maps package and extends the Table class, integrating with other components like Table1D for axes and DataCell for individual data points.

classes.name: Table3D
classes.description: Represents a 3D data table with methods for data manipulation, display, and clipboard interactions within a GUI.

classes.name: CopySelection3DWorker
classes.description: A SwingWorker class that handles copying selected cells or entire tables to the clipboard asynchronously.

classes.name: CopyTable3DWorker
classes.description: A SwingWorker class that handles copying the entire table data to the clipboard asynchronously.

methods.name: drawTable
methods.description: Renders the data cells and axis labels of the table.

methods.name: populateTable
methods.description: Populates the table with data from a byte array, updating cells based on storage type.

methods.name: updateTableLabel
methods.description: Updates the labels indicating axis names and units.

methods.name: calcCellRanges
methods.description: Calculates the min and max values for bin and comparison, updating cell range stats.

methods.name: getTableAsString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the table data.

methods.name: populateCompareValues
methods.description: Populates comparison values from another table for differential analysis.

methods.name: refreshCompare
methods.description: Refreshes comparison data and updates display.

methods.name: getFrameSize
methods.description: Calculates and returns the table's display size.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string description of the table, indicating it is a 3D table.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Increments values of selected data cells.

methods.name: multiply
methods.description: Multiplies values of selected data cells by a factor.

methods.name: clearSelection
methods.description: Clears all current cell selections.

methods.name: clearSelectedData
methods.description: Clears the selected state of data cells.

methods.name: highlight
methods.description: Highlights cells within a coordinate range.

methods.name: stopHighlight
methods.description: Stops highlighting cells and preserves their selected state.

methods.name: setRevertPoint
methods.description: Sets the current state as a revert point for undo operations.

methods.name: undoAll
methods.description: Reverts all data cells to their revert points.

methods.name: undoSelected
methods.description: Reverts only selected data cells to their revert points.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Converts the table data into a byte array suitable for saving in a binary file.

methods.name: setRealValue
methods.description: Sets a real (numeric) value to all selected data cells.

methods.name: addKeyListener
methods.description: Adds a key listener to axis labels and data cells for keyboard interaction.

methods.name: selectCellAt
methods.description: Selects a cell based on axis type and coordinates.

methods.name: deSelectCellAt
methods.description: Deselects a specific cell.

methods.name: cursorUp
methods.description: Moves the selection cursor up.

methods.name: cursorDown
methods.description: Moves the selection cursor down.

methods.name: cursorLeft
methods.description: Moves the selection cursor left.

methods.name: cursorRight
methods.description: Moves the selection cursor right.

methods.name: startHighlight
methods.description: Begins cell highlighting given start coordinates.

methods.name: copySelection
methods.description: Copies selected data cells asynchronously to the clipboard.

methods.name: copyTable
methods.description: Copies the entire table data asynchronously to the clipboard.

methods.name: paste
methods.description: Pastes data from the clipboard into the table, supporting different paste formats.

methods.name: pasteValues
methods.description: Pastes cell values from clipboard into selected area.

methods.name: verticalInterpolate
methods.description: Interpolates missing or selected data along the vertical axis.

methods.name: horizontalInterpolate
methods.description: Interpolates missing or selected data along the horizontal axis.

methods.name: interpolate
methods.description: Performs both vertical and horizontal interpolation.

methods.name: isLiveDataSupported
methods.description: Returns whether live data overlay is supported based on axis parameters.

methods.name: isButtonSelected
methods.description: Indicates whether the table is associated with a button (always true).

methods.name: highlightLiveData
methods.description: Highlights live data trace at current indices in overlay log mode.

methods.name: updateLiveDataHighlight
methods.description: Updates the highlight of live data in overlay mode.

methods.name: clearLiveDataTrace
methods.description: Clears any live data tracing highlights from axes and cells.

methods.name: get3dData
methods.description: Returns the internal data array of DataCells representing the 3D table.

methods.name: setCompareDisplay
methods.description: Sets display mode for comparison, propagating to axes.

methods.name: setCompareValueType
methods.description: Sets comparison value type, propagating to axes.

methods.name: setCurrentScale
methods.description: Sets the current scale for axes and updates labels.

methods.name: getLogParamString
methods.description: Returns a string summarizing log parameters for overlay.

methods.name: setOverlayLog
methods.description: Enables or disables overlay log mode, clearing traces if enabled.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality between this table and another, considering multiple properties.

methods.name: repaint
methods.description: Repaints the table and its axes.
